title: Falcon direction setter accepts failed/mismatched acknowledgements
description:
`rotator_falcon/indigo_rotator_falcon.driver:222` tests `!falcon_command(...) && !strncmp(response, "FN:", 3)`. A transport-successful reply `ERR` makes the first operand false and never sets ALERT. A failed command with a different/empty reply also makes the prefix operand false. The generated prologue therefore publishes the requested reversal OK even when its acknowledgement is invalid or absent. `driver-b-evidence/falcon-direction-truth-table.json` records the exact Boolean truth table, not a hardware test. Remediation: require transport success AND valid acknowledgement (failure OR invalid prefix), preserve/read back prior direction on failure, and regress success/refusal/timeout/stale reply combinations. Keep changes in the .driver and regenerate without changing generator semantics.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261023101753-bc8d-complete-repository-audit-028.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
